Restyled (2026-08-20): the 'Estimation period' bars now use a single fixed color (CYCLE_COLORS[0]) for all 23 cycles, replacing the previous per-cycle cycle_color() 5-color rotation; the 'Calibration record' bars remain unchanged gray (TRAINING_COLOR). Also picks up the shared apply_panel_style() major/minor tick-length increase (applies to all figures using that function: 7, 8, 9, 10/11). No filter concept applies to this script -- load_rows() reads the full frozen predictions.parquet checkpoint and this figure plots all 23 complete six-month evaluation cycles unconditionally.

Restyled (2026-08-20): band/line/marker color fixed to CYCLE_COLORS[0] for every cycle (was per-cycle cycle_color()); gray vertical axvline separators added at each cycle's block_start, drawn dashed (linestyle='--') with alpha=0.5 (was solid, fully opaque, at linewidth=1) to sit more quietly behind the data; major gridlines removed (axis.grid(False, which='both') after apply_panel_style(), y=0 reference line kept); legend now correctly restricted to this page's S1 panel only via 'if show_legend and section == sections[0]' -- fixes a pre-existing latent bug where the show_legend parameter was accepted but never read, so the legend previously rendered on all 3 sections of this page (and, incorrectly, on the S4-S6 continuation page too). Also picks up the shared apply_panel_style() major/minor tick-length increase.

Same styling changes as fig_results_delayed_monthly_estimates_s1_s3 (fixed blue band/line/marker, dashed gray alpha=0.5 vertical separators, no gridlines, tick-length increase). The legend-fix described in that entry means this page's legend is now correctly suppressed (show_legend=False), whereas before the fix it incorrectly rendered on all 3 sections here as well.

Tick label fontsize increased by 2 (from TICK_FONT_SIZE - 1 to TICK_FONT_SIZE - 1 + 2, i.e. 11pt to 13pt) via this function's own axis.tick_params(labelsize=...) override, which sits after and overrides apply_panel_style()'s default y-tick styling for this figure only. Tick *length* (major/minor) still comes from the shared apply_panel_style() increase, since this figure's own override only sets labelsize, not length. R2/RMSE/MAE values and scatter content unchanged. No filter concept applies -- all 6 sections plotted from the full checkpoint with no subsetting beyond section membership.
